generation_settings.grammar:
json-array ::= "[" space ("]" | json-value (space "," space json-value)* space "]")
json-bool ::= "true" | "false"
json-null ::= "null"
json-number ::= "-"? ("0" | [1-9] [0-9]*) ("." [0-9]+)? (("e" | "E") [+-]? [0-9]+)?
json-object ::= "{" space ("}" | json-string space ":" space json-value (space "," space json-string space ":" space json-value)* space "}")
json-string ::= "\"" ( [^"\\] | "\\" ( ["\\/ bfnrt] | "u" [0-9a-fA-F]{4} ) )* "\""
json-value ::= json-object | json-array | json-string | json-number | json-bool | json-null
response-format ::= "{" space response-format-branch-kv space "}"
response-format-branch ::= ("\"auto_approve\"" | "\"requires_manager_approval\"" | "\"reject_out_of_policy\"")
response-format-branch-kv ::= "\"branch\"" space ":" space response-format-branch
root ::= "<|im_start|>assistant\n" "<think>" space until-2 space "</think>" space response-format
space ::= | " " | "\n"{1,2} [ \t]{0,20}
until-2 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [^<] until-2
until-2-01 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [/] until-2-02 | [^/<] until-2
until-2-02 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [t] until-2-03 | [^<t] until-2
until-2-03 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [h] until-2-04 | [^<h] until-2
until-2-04 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [i] until-2-05 | [^<i] until-2
until-2-05 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [n] until-2-06 | [^<n] until-2

until-2-07 ::= | [<] until-2-01 | [^<>] until-2
